WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h

            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )

        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)

        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )
    SELECT c.ordinal FROM completed c

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )
    SELECT c.ordinal FROM completed c

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

SELECT status, id, lease_marker, context, timeout_ms, context_bytes,
                CASE WHEN $6::boolean AND status = '<literal>'
                    THEN mesh_jobs.now_ms()::text END AS observed_at_ms, ordinality::text
         FROM mesh_jobs.claim_batch_set_v1($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::bigint, $5::integer, NULL)
         WITH ORDINALITY

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )
    SELECT c.ordinal FROM completed c

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

        lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL, cancel_requested_at_ms = NULL,
        errors = CASE WHEN reason IS NULL THEN job.errors ELSE

            jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('<literal>', now_at, '<literal>', job.attempt, '<literal>', reason))

WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_lease_marker, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, lease_markers) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, lease_marker, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_lease_marker) = (p.id, p.lease_marker)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(lease_markers) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_lease_marker = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_lease_marker = h.lease_lease_marker
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )
    SELECT c.ordinal FROM completed c

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
                '<literal>', p.version, '<literal>', p.args, '<literal>', p.attempt + 1,
                '<literal>', p.max_attempts, '<literal>', p.queue, '<literal>', p.metadata,
                '<literal>', p.tags, '<literal>', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_lease_marker = s.grant_lease_marker,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_lease_marker, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT '<literal>'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_lease_marker::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position

        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_lease_marker,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                '<literal>', p.id, '<literal>', p.id::text || '<literal>' || p.run::text, '<literal>', p.worker,
